configuration: Pinned SWMF IM/CIMI unit_test_localwave target, configured with the source's -EarthHO -GridDefault setup. The unit test preserves its source defaults: the hard-coded energy and pitch-angle grids, analytic synthetic PSD, 149 nT field, 16e6 m^-3 density, one-second step and 60-step window; no external input file is exposed.
observable: the local-wave production files for phase-space density, interpolated phase-space density, parallel and perpendicular PSD derivatives, and resonant frequencies/wave power
default_vs_upstream: upstream target and source defaults; the source target has no baseline/check recipe
variant: identical to nominal: the pinned unit_test_localwave has no input file or runtime parameter to perturb without changing source code; this supplies no calibration spread and is not evidence of implementation invariance
altbuild: none: no alternative build is claimed before calibration

evidence.note: Proposed policy and bound only; no reference baseline, runtime, floor, or PASS result is claimed. Human curator owns calibration and final tolerance.

warrant: This is a provisional pointwise policy for the physical values emitted by unit_test_localwave.write_debug_output: the PSD and its derivatives are the phase-space distribution and local gradients used by the wave operator, while localwave_resonances.dat records resonant frequencies, wave numbers and wave power. A wrong interpolation, derivative, resonance calculation or wave-power update changes those production quantities. The bound is deliberately unmeasured because the source exposes no baseline/check recipe and no active input for a calibration perturbation; a fresh reference and target-host calibration must establish whether pointwise comparison is retained and what tolerance is physically achievable.
